phases.title: Initial medication plan
phases.description: Follistim and Menopur are grouped into the first example plan. Open it to follow the preparation and injection guides.

phases.title: Updated plan: an added medication
phases.description: This example adds Ganirelix / Fyremadel alongside Follistim and Menopur. The initial plan remains available for reference.

steps.title: Check the cartridge in your pen
steps.description: Check your cartridge log for the amount remaining before preparing your dose. Medicine remaining in the cartridge is separate from the dose shown in the dose window.
steps.sourceNote: For loading a new cartridge or an amount that will not cover the dose, use the full Follistim Pen instructions.

steps.title: Attach the pen needle
steps.description: Clean the pen end with an alcohol swab. Peel the capsule seal, then push and twist the capsule onto the pen. After the outer capsule comes off, a smaller inner needle cover remains.

steps.title: Check medicine flow before dialing
steps.description: Use the Follistim Pen flow-check instructions for a new or partially used cartridge before setting the dose. These are different sequences; the linked instructions show both.

steps.title: Set and check your prescribed dose
steps.description: Check that the medicine is clear and the dose window starts at zero. Set your prescribed dose, then check the dose window. Use the current prescribed amount each time.

steps.title: Prepare the site and position the pen
steps.description: Clean the chosen skin area and let it dry. Remove the inner needle cover before the injection. The linked demonstration describes a 45°–90° range; the manufacturer instructions specify 90°. Use the directions taught for your pen and needle.
steps.sourceNote: The diagram distinguishes the two sources. It does not specify insertion depth or hand position.

steps.title: Use the pen injection button
steps.description: The Follistim Pen delivers medicine with its injection button. Follow the linked administration sequence for pressing the button, waiting before withdrawal and checking the dose window.

steps.title: Keep track of the cartridge
steps.description: Keep a separate log of new cartridges, doses taken and medicine remaining so you know when to switch cartridges. This guide does not create that log.

steps.title: Check your vial count and diluent amount
steps.description: Set out the prescribed number of Menopur powder vials and the separate diluent vial. Read their labels; cap color alone does not identify them.

steps.title: Prepare the vial tops
steps.description: Remove the vial caps and wipe the tops with an alcohol swab. Keep the powder and diluent vials distinct.

steps.title: Connect the syringe to the Q-Cap
steps.description: The Q-Cap connects the diluent vial and syringe. Follow the demonstration for placing it onto the vial, removing its protective carrier and connecting the syringe at the top. The injection needle is a separate item.

steps.title: Draw up the prescribed diluent amount
steps.description: Use the linked preparation sequence to withdraw the amount of diluent specified in your instructions. The powder-vial count and diluent amount are separate parts of the plan.

steps.title: Mix the powder
steps.description: Add the diluent to the first powder vial and withdraw the dissolved mixture. If your instructions call for additional powder vials, use that mixture for the next vial in the prescribed sequence.
steps.sourceLabel: Mixing one or more vials · page 5
steps.sourceNote: The video demonstration uses one powder vial. Your prescribed vial count may differ.

steps.title: Prepare the separate injection needle
steps.description: After the prescribed mixing sequence, withdraw the mixture. Change from the Q-Cap to the separate injection needle specified in your instructions. Watch the demonstration for the air-bubble and drop-check step.
steps.sourceNote: This demonstration uses one powder vial; it does not set your prescribed vial count.

steps.title: Position the syringe at 90°
steps.description: Use the prepared injection site. Hold the Menopur syringe at 90° to the skin surface. The syringe delivers medicine with its plunger; the Follistim Pen uses an injection button.

steps.title: Follow the injection and disposal sequence
steps.description: Use the linked sequence for insertion, pressing the plunger, withdrawal and disposal. Keep the syringe and needle handling together with the instructions for your supplies.

steps.title: Set out the prefilled syringe
steps.description: Wash your hands. Set out the prefilled syringe, an alcohol swab and a sharps container. These steps follow the prefilled syringe shown in the linked demonstration.

steps.title: Move the air bubble toward the top
steps.description: With the cap still on, gently flick the syringe barrel to move the air bubble toward the top, as shown in the demonstration.

steps.title: Remove the cap and clear the air
steps.description: Remove the cap. Gently press the plunger upward to clear the air bubble, without pushing out medicine.

steps.title: Prepare the abdominal site
steps.description: Before the injection, put the cap back on and set the syringe aside while preparing the site, as shown in this demonstration. Clean the chosen abdominal site with an alcohol swab.
steps.sourceNote: The cap replacement shown here is before injection, not after the needle has been used.

steps.title: Position the syringe at 45°–90°
steps.description: Remove the cap for the injection. Hold the syringe at 45°–90° to the skin surface, as demonstrated. Insert the needle fully so no needle shaft remains visible above the skin; keep the hub above the skin.
steps.sourceNote: This depicts the prefilled syringe demonstration, not a universal instruction for other devices.

steps.title: Press the plunger all the way down
steps.description: After inserting the needle as shown in the demonstration, use your other hand to press the plunger all the way down.

steps.title: Withdraw and dispose of the syringe
steps.description: Follow the demonstration for withdrawing the syringe, then put the used syringe directly into the sharps container.
